currentRisks: There is no dedicated CI workflow for typecheck, tests, and build verification.
`src/services/clip-service/clipExporter.ts` is a known browser build boundary risk for the root application build.
Feature metadata files under `project-meta/features/` are empty, reducing the quality of generated content and snapshots.
`project-meta/status/roadmap.json` is empty, so roadmap prioritization relies on secondary docs instead of structured metadata.
developmentPriorities: Fix root typecheck regressions so repository quality gates can pass consistently.
Fix the browser-incompatible clip exporter boundary in the root application build path.
Populate `project-meta/*` so generated website content and snapshots stop depending on empty metadata.
Regenerate context artifacts after agent, workflow, or architecture changes to avoid documentation drift.
Introduce a dedicated CI workflow for test, typecheck, and build verification.
